text: can you put tooltips on all the buttons here the 12E one is confusing me lol
resolution: Added hover tooltips to every button in the Studio editor toolbar (the framework already supports a tooltip prop on Pressable, auto-positioned by tooltip.zig; only one button had one before). Covered all clusters across four commits: tier-1 (scale ghost, the ⇄ X/Y/Z mirror chips, smooth/log-cam/fps levers, the FRAMES ↺ reset — the cryptic glyph the user read as '12E'); the selection modes (object/vertex/edge/face/rig/paint) with per-mode descriptions; transform (move/resize/rotate); symmetrize keep+/keep-; paint (colour swatches, eraser, brush sizes, clear paint); rig (+pivot, +joint, ⇄ mirror joint); the face/edge edit ops (extrude, loop cut, flip, glass, detach, edge extrude, create face, ⌖ wheel center, ⊚ make wheel); the texture row (textureize, ⚙ compile, textured/solid, export/import/ai-fill sheet + per-face slice); and the fov −/+ + reframe. 39 tooltips total. Each explains what the button does (and the symbol buttons ⌖ ⊚ ⇄ ☖ ↺ now self-explain). Worked in re-read-before-edit chunks + committed in 4 parts to coexist with the other active session editing the same file; full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed across parts ending 9c156fae1.
